normative_extracts.quote: The & nesting selector represents the elements matched by the parent rule, behaving with the specificity of :is() wrapping the parent selector list.

browser_support.notes: CSS Nesting (including bare tag names) is Baseline Newly Available since late 2023; @scope reached broad support by 2025/2026.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Nesting desugars to :is(parent) child; @scope bounds matching between root and limit and adds scoping proximity to the cascade.

production_failures.symptom: Nested rule inside #id, .card unexpectedly gains ID-level specificity for .card children
production_failures.root_cause: & desugars to :is(#id, .card), which takes the highest specificity in the selector list.
production_failures.mitigation: Avoid mixing high- and low-specificity selectors in the same parent list, or wrap in :where().

production_failures.symptom: Parent .theme-dark styles leak into nested .theme-light card slots
production_failures.root_cause: Equal specificity falls back to source order instead of DOM closeness.
production_failures.mitigation: Use @scope (.theme-dark) { ... } so the closer DOM ancestor wins via scoping proximity.
